QUOTE: It installs its own functions by calling `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`. It uses the mutexed variants when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says mutexed variants are used under MBEDTLS_THREADING_C but doesn't state the plain pair otherwise or that the choice is made at compile time inside the init function.
